query: UPDATE central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work SET delivery_state = 'pending', retry_attempt = retry_attempt + 1, failure_class = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, claim_token_hash = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, retry_not_before = NULL, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND delivery_state = 'failed' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs AS epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $2)
